_about: Planted-defect expectations for scripts/smoke_scanners.py. Per tool: the exit codes that mean 'ran normally' and the checks that must ALL pass. A check passes when at least one SARIF result in `output` (default: every SARIF output of the tool) has a rule id or rule text containing one of `any_of` (case-insensitive substring) and, when `path_contains` is set, a location whose path contains it. Edit `any_of` deliberately when a scanner renames a rule; never widen it to something the fixture did not plant.
